import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source = root.parent / 'pr-986-result-accounting-source'
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, str(source / 'bindings/benchmarks'))
import run

raw = []
for case in ('fill_bulk', 'point', 'select'):
    for size in (1000, 10000):
        fixture = run.fixture(size, case)
        for backend in ('memory', 'file'):
            for iteration in range(10):
                order = ['baseline', 'candidate'] if iteration % 2 == 0 else ['candidate', 'baseline']
                for name in order:
                    stem = f'{case}-{size}-{backend}-{iteration}-{name.ljust(9, "_")}'
                    job = dict(fixture, backend=backend, path=str(root / 'fixtures' / stem))
                    (root / 'fixtures').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
                    job_path = root / 'fixtures' / (stem + '.job.json')
                    assert not job_path.exists(), 'Use fresh fixtures'
                    encoded = json.dumps(job, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))
                    job_path.write_text(encoded)
                    process = subprocess.run([str(root / 'artifacts' / name), str(job_path)], capture_output=True, text=True)
                    record = json.loads(process.stdout)
                    record.update(revision=name, size=size, backend=backend, case=case, iteration=iteration, order=order, discarded=iteration == 0, process_exit=process.returncode, stderr=process.stderr, fixture_sha256=hashlib.sha256(encoded.encode()).hexdigest())
                    record['parity'] = record.get('status') == 'ok' and record.get('checksum') == fixture['expected_checksum'] and record.get('output_rows') == size
                    record['qualified'] = record['parity'] and process.returncode == 0 and record.get('native_profile') is None and record.get('durability') == 'SyncOnEveryWrite' and record.get('prefetch') == 0 and record.get('query_boundary_ns') == record.get('write_boundary_ns', 0) + record.get('read_boundary_ns', 0)
                    raw.append(record)
                    (root / 'raw-partial.json').write_text(json.dumps(raw, indent=2) + '\n')
summary = []
for case in ('fill_bulk', 'point', 'select'):
    for size in (1000, 10000):
        for backend in ('memory', 'file'):
            groups = {name: [r for r in raw if r['case'] == case and r['size'] == size and r['backend'] == backend and r['revision'] == name and not r['discarded']] for name in ('baseline', 'candidate')}
            qualified = all(len(g) == 9 and all(r['qualified'] for r in g) for g in groups.values())
            entry = dict(case=case, size=size, backend=backend, qualified=qualified)
            if qualified:
                metrics = ('elapsed_ns', 'query_boundary_ns', 'write_boundary_ns', 'read_boundary_ns') if case == 'fill_bulk' else ('elapsed_ns', 'query_boundary_ns', 'read_boundary_ns')
                for metric in metrics:
                    ratios = [groups['baseline'][i][metric] / groups['candidate'][i][metric] for i in range(9)]
                    median = statistics.median(ratios)
                    entry[metric] = dict(paired_median_speedup=median, paired_mad=statistics.median(abs(x-median) for x in ratios), min_speedup=min(ratios), pairs=ratios)
            summary.append(entry)
report = dict(raw=raw, summary=summary, binary_sha256={n: hashlib.sha256((root / 'artifacts' / n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in ('baseline', 'candidate')}, scope='Actual ordinary Rust fill_bulk/point/select 1k/10k memory/file, parent72 versus incremental mutation-limit prototype, default SyncOnEveryWrite and budgets; custom Cargo release ARM64 alternating pairs. Excludes default Bazel/Linux, Python/Go, sequential fill, wide, graph/FTS, whole-memory/tails/source reuse, and comprehensive acceptance.')
(root / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(summary))
